stats.text: As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, you present your {ref:equipment/holy-symbol} and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of {ref:glossary/hit-points} equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you), and divide those Hit Points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.
